prompt_text: Who is the best mortgage lender in Fort Lauderdale FL for a home purchase loan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one universally “best” lender—the right choice depends on your credit, down payment, loan type, property, and whether you value a local loan officer or a fully online process.

**A good starting point:** get quotes from **one local mortgage broker, one bank or credit union, and one lender approved for any assistance program you may use**. Local brokers can compare multiple lenders; banks and credit unions may be competitive for some borrowers. The available local data also lists lenders such as **Chase, City National Bank of Florida, and A&D Mortgage**, but that alone doesn’t establish which will offer you the best deal.

If you may qualify for help with your down payment or closing costs, check **Broward County’s Home Buyer Program** and **Florida Housing’s Homebuyer Program**. Both require working with an eligible lender, and Broward County provides a participating-lender list.

Ask each lender for a written **Loan Estimate** for the same loan amount, down payment, rate-lock period, and loan type. Compare the **APR, lender fees, points, cash to close, and rate-lock terms**—not just the advertised interest rate. A lender’s quote is only meaningful for your specific application and property.
